What to look for: both DXC panes stop with a diagnostic and emit no disassembly
at all -- no shader body, no binding table, no signature rows. That is the bug
report: this shader is rejected rather than compiled.

The FXC panes are the contrast the issue is filed on. The 5.0 pane assembles the
shader; the 5.1 pane does not. The reporter's own follow-up comment describes the
same split, so treat this as corroboration of the report rather than as an
isolated experiment -- the two FXC panes differ in compiler build as well as in
target profile.

Compiler Explorer's oldest DXC is 1.6.2112, which already postdates the change
measured locally: v1.4.1907 compiles this shader and v1.5.2010 is the first
release that rejects it. No pane here can show the era in which it worked; that
contrast lives in the captured local output attached to the triage notes.

The diagnostic's exact wording is deliberately not quoted in this banner, because
Compiler Explorer compiles the banner into the module alongside the shader and a
quoted message would plant its own search hit.
